breaking.change: The RPG action HUD's effects row, input hints and loot feed are now built from blocks, as its plates are: RpgEffect, RpgHint and RpgLootEntry. Their props and look are unchanged. The parts of what a block now draws moved to the block: RpgEffects.tile, .art, .timer and .time, RpgHints.key and .action, and RpgLootFeed.art, .item, .rarity and .count are gone. RpgEffects.effect, RpgHints.hint and RpgLootFeed.entry remain as the places of the blocks.
breaking.fix: In a style pack or a game's CSS, style the blocks' parts: RpgEffect.effect, .tile, .art, .timer and .time; RpgHint.hint, .key and .action; RpgLootEntry.entry, .edge, .art, .item, .rarity and .count.

added.summary: More of the RPG action HUD's blocks, usable by name in a game's own HUD: one buff or debuff tile (its time as a radial sweep and a tag), one key cap with its action, and one looted row (edge by rarity, name, rarity tag, count). A game lays them out with flex or grid where it wants them.
